requirements.statement: Material CLI/domain results use a versioned deterministic response envelope and reject unsupported contract versions predictably.
Lifecycle records carry validated mission, change, run, operation, and evidence correlation identifiers without allowing caller-supplied authority.
Provider adapter declarations are explicit, redacted, disabled by default, and cannot authorize or execute a durable mutation.
Existing evidence, authorization, and sealed-tree boundaries remain enforced through the new contract surfaces.
